_note: The English source-of-truth document for the zen-man UI (plan §5.4/§5.9, apps/zenman/build.rs).
craft-i18n looks up English source text and returns it unchanged when there is no translation
(craft_i18n::Lang::EN), so this file is NOT embedded: build.rs parses it to prove it is well
formed and then skips it. Rows arrive with the panels that need them, in step 7 (plan §5.8);
until then the honest content of a source-language catalog is two empty maps.
Shape: { locale, shared: { context: { Source text: translation } }, app: { … } } where `app` is
zen-man's own catalog and `shared` the craft-i18n rows it overrides.
